## Practice Warm-up Test

::: {.callout-note}
This is a **practice test** and does not count towards your grade.

You have **10 minutes** from the moment you start. You may run your code while working. There is no correctness feedback. Submit your solution before the timer reaches zero; if the page remains open, it will be submitted automatically when time expires.

**Test window rule:** During the test, you must remain on this test page. Do not switch to another browser tab, window, or application. The **first detected switch** results in a warning. The **second detected switch** automatically submits your current solution and ends the test.
:::

Enter your **Neptun code** and start the test. Your seminar group and task will be assigned automatically.

```{=html}
<style>
#warmup-app { max-width: 980px; margin: 1rem 0; }
.warmup-row { display:flex; gap:.6rem; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:.7rem 0; }
#warmup-app input { max-width: 180px; text-transform: uppercase; }
#warmup-app button { padding:.45rem .8rem; }
#warmup-panel { display:none; margin-top:1.2rem; }
#warmup-meta { display:flex; gap:1.2rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:.6rem 0 1rem; }
#warmup-task { padding:1rem; border:1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius:.4rem; margin-bottom:1rem; }\n#warmup-task p { margin:.45rem 0; }\n#warmup-task ul { margin:.35rem 0 .75rem 1.25rem; }
#code-editor { width:100%; min-height:330px; font-family:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size:14px; padding:.8rem; }
#program-output { min-height:90px; white-space:pre-wrap; padding:.8rem; border:1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius:.4rem; background:#f7f7f7; }
#warmup-message { font-weight:600; }
.timer-warning { font-weight:700; }
.submitted-box { padding:1rem; border:1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius:.4rem; }
.rules-ack { margin:.8rem 0; }
#warmup-warning-overlay {
  display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:99999;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.55); align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:1rem;
}
#warmup-warning-dialog {
  max-width:560px; background:white; padding:1.4rem; border-radius:.5rem;
  box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
#warmup-warning-dialog h3 { margin-top:0; }
</style>

<div id="warmup-app">
  <div id="start-panel">
    <div class="warmup-row">
      <label for="neptun"><strong>Neptun code</strong></label>
      <input id="neptun" maxlength="6" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <div class="rules-ack">
      <label>
        <input id="accept-rules" type="checkbox">
        I have read and understood the test rules, including the window-switch rule.
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="warmup-row">
      <button id="start-warmup" type="button">Start Warm-up Test</button>
    </div>
    <p id="warmup-message"></p>
  </div>

  <div id="warmup-panel">
    <div id="warmup-meta">
      <span><strong>Group:</strong> <span id="group-value"></span></span>
      <span><strong>Time remaining:</strong> <span id="timer">10:00</span></span>
    </div>

    <div id="warmup-task"></div>

    <label for="code-editor"><strong>Your Python solution</strong></label>
    <textarea id="code-editor" spellcheck="false"></textarea>

    <div class="warmup-row">
      <button id="run-code" type="button">Run</button>
      <button id="submit-code" type="button">Submit</button>
      <span id="runtime-status"></span>
    </div>

    <p><strong>Program output</strong></p>
    <pre id="program-output"></pre>
    <p id="submission-message"></p>
  </div>

  <div id="warmup-warning-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="warmup-warning-title">
    <div id="warmup-warning-dialog">
      <h3 id="warmup-warning-title">Warning – window switch detected</h3>
      <p>You left the test window. This is your first warning.</p>
      <p><strong>If you leave the test window again, your current solution will be submitted automatically and the test will end.</strong></p>
      <button id="continue-test" type="button">Continue test</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/pyodide.js"></script>

<script>
(() => {
  const API_BASE = "https://itarch-backend-fpdsf6brfpanf5d8.northeurope-01.azurewebsites.net/api";
  const WEEK = "03";

  let assignment = null;
  let pyodide = null;
  let runCount = 0;
  let timerHandle = null;
  let submitting = false;
  let submitted = false;
  let focusLossCount = 0;
  let hiddenSince = null;
  let visibilityCheckHandle = null;
  const FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS = 1500;

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const neptunInput = $("neptun");
  const startButton = $("start-warmup");
  const startMessage = $("warmup-message");
  const panel = $("warmup-panel");
  const editor = $("code-editor");
  const output = $("program-output");
  const runButton = $("run-code");
  const submitButton = $("submit-code");
  const runtimeStatus = $("runtime-status");
  const submissionMessage = $("submission-message");
  const acceptRules = $("accept-rules");
  const warningOverlay = $("warmup-warning-overlay");
  const continueTestButton = $("continue-test");

  const savedNeptun = localStorage.getItem("pycourse_neptun");
  if (savedNeptun) neptunInput.value = savedNeptun;

  function validNeptun(value) {
    return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test(value);
  }

  async function postJson(url, body) {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    let data = {};
    try { data = await response.json(); } catch (_) {}
    if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
      throw new Error(data.error || `Request failed (${response.status}).`);
    }
    return data;
  }

  function formatRemaining(ms) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 1000));
    const min = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const sec = total % 60;
    return `${min}:${String(sec).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  function startTimer() {
    clearInterval(timerHandle);
    const tick = async () => {
      const remaining = new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime() - Date.now();
      $("timer").textContent = formatRemaining(remaining);
      $("timer").classList.toggle("timer-warning", remaining <= 60000);
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(timerHandle);
        await submitSolution("timeout");
      }
    };
    tick();
    timerHandle = setInterval(tick, 1000);
  }

  function showAssignment(data) {
    assignment = data;
    $("group-value").textContent = data.group;
    $("warmup-task").innerHTML = data.task.text;
    startButton.disabled = true;
    neptunInput.disabled = true;
    acceptRules.disabled = true;
    panel.style.display = "block";
    startTimer();
  }

  startButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const neptun = neptunInput.value.trim().toUpperCase();
    neptunInput.value = neptun;

    if (!validNeptun(neptun)) {
      startMessage.textContent = "Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";
      return;
    }

    if (!acceptRules.checked) {
      startMessage.textContent = "Please confirm that you have read and understood the test rules.";
      return;
    }

    startButton.disabled = true;
    startMessage.textContent = "Starting...";
    try {
      const data = await postJson(`${API_BASE}/startWarmup`, {neptun, week: WEEK});
      localStorage.setItem("pycourse_neptun", neptun);
      startMessage.textContent = "";
      showAssignment(data);
    } catch (err) {
      startMessage.textContent = err.message;
      startButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  function showFirstFocusWarning() {
    editor.disabled = true;
    runButton.disabled = true;
    submitButton.disabled = true;
    warningOverlay.style.display = "flex";
  }

  continueTestButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    warningOverlay.style.display = "none";
    if (!submitted && !submitting) {
      editor.disabled = false;
      runButton.disabled = false;
      submitButton.disabled = false;
      editor.focus();
    }
  });

  async function registerFocusLoss() {
    if (!assignment || submitted || submitting) return;

    focusLossCount += 1;

    if (focusLossCount === 1) {
      showFirstFocusWarning();
      return;
    }

    // Second detected switch: submit immediately using the existing backend.
    warningOverlay.style.display = "none";
    await submitSolution("window_switch");
  }

  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!assignment || submitted || submitting) return;

    if (document.hidden) {
      hiddenSince = Date.now();

      clearTimeout(visibilityCheckHandle);
      visibilityCheckHandle = setTimeout(() => {
        if (
          document.hidden &&
          hiddenSince !== null &&
          Date.now() - hiddenSince >= FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS
        ) {
          // Count the event while the page is hidden. This is important on the
          // second switch so submission can start without waiting for return.
          hiddenSince = null;
          registerFocusLoss();
        }
      }, FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS);
    } else {
      clearTimeout(visibilityCheckHandle);
      visibilityCheckHandle = null;
      hiddenSince = null;
    }
  });

  async function ensurePyodide() {
    if (pyodide) return pyodide;
    runtimeStatus.textContent = "Loading Python...";
    pyodide = await loadPyodide();
    runtimeStatus.textContent = "Python ready.";
    return pyodide;
  }

  runButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (!assignment || submitted) return;
    if (Date.now() >= new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime()) {
      await submitSolution("timeout");
      return;
    }

    runButton.disabled = true;
    output.textContent = "";
    try {
      const py = await ensurePyodide();
      py.setStdout({batched: (s) => { output.textContent += s + "\n"; }});
      py.setStderr({batched: (s) => { output.textContent += s + "\n"; }});

      // Browser-backed stdin so Python input() works in Pyodide.
      py.setStdin({
        stdin: () => {
          const value = window.prompt("Python input:");
          if (value === null) {
            throw new Error("Input cancelled.");
          }
          return value;
        }
      });

      runCount += 1;
      await py.runPythonAsync(editor.value);
    } catch (err) {
      output.textContent += String(err);
    } finally {
      if (!submitted) runButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  async function submitSolution(type) {
    if (!assignment || submitted || submitting) return;
    submitting = true;
    runButton.disabled = true;
    submitButton.disabled = true;
    editor.disabled = true;
    submissionMessage.textContent =
      type === "timeout" ? "Time is up. Submitting..." :
      type === "window_switch" ? "Second window switch detected. Submitting your current solution..." :
      "Submitting...";

    try {
      const data = await postJson(`${API_BASE}/submitWarmup`, {
        neptun: neptunInput.value.trim().toUpperCase(),
        week: WEEK,
        assignment_id: assignment.assignment_id,
        code: editor.value,
        run_count: runCount,
        submission_type: type
      });

      submitted = true;
      clearInterval(timerHandle);
      $("warmup-task").style.display = "none";
      output.style.display = "none";
      runtimeStatus.textContent = "";

      submissionMessage.className = "submitted-box";
      if (type === "timeout") {
        submissionMessage.textContent =
          "Time is up. Your solution has been submitted automatically. Your result will be available by the next class at the latest.";
      } else if (type === "window_switch") {
        submissionMessage.textContent =
          "Test ended. A second window switch was detected. According to the test rules, your current solution has been submitted automatically. Your result will be available by the next class at the latest.";
      } else {
        submissionMessage.textContent =
          data.message || "Submission successful. Your result will be available by the next class at the latest.";
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Do not claim success until the backend confirms storage.
      editor.disabled = false;
      if (Date.now() < new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime()) {
        runButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.disabled = false;
      } else {
        // Keep Submit available after a failed timeout submission so the student can retry.
        submitButton.disabled = false;
      }
      submissionMessage.textContent = `Submission failed: ${err.message} Please try Submit again.`;
    } finally {
      submitting = false;
    }
  }

  submitButton.addEventListener("click", () => submitSolution("manual"));
})();
</script>
```
